(2) C6 (linked to PF2): revise the check so it recognizes the maintenance-entry requirement as satisfied when the settlement includes any commitment of type 'equipment_status_update'/'equipment_status_board_update' or any commitment whose detail mentions 'maintenance entry,' 'battery swap,' or 'equipment status board' — rollout 3 explicitly says 'Post SFC Tan's maintenance entry' yet C6 still fails. (3) For rollout 2's turn-cap failure: either raise the turn_cap to accommodate A1's deliberative style, or adjust the settle-eligibility condition so that once both PF1 and PF2 have been revealed and the core decisions (kit assignment, swap time, swap duration) are stated in conversation, A1 is eligible to settle without requiring external confirmation that is not available from any agent in the scenario.
